verdict.rationale: PayPal's agent toolkit documents first-class refund tools: create_refund issues a full or partial refund on a captured payment and get_refund retrieves its status. The toolkit SDK is live on npm with refunds in scope, and these tools run on the same REST payments rails that Store Sync agent orders use via Orders v2. missing for 10: explicit documentation of refunds on Braintree-processed agent orders (ACP/UCP delegated-token paths), named refund webhook event types for async tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-order refund flows.
